concept: IAM: least-privilege Lambda execution role (sns:Publish on an ARN)
tests: How to correctly give Lambda permission to publish to a specific SNS topic with least privilege.
expected: The function's execution role with an sns:Publish policy scoped to the specific topic ARN. Triggers: "Lambda", "publish to SNS", "least privilege".
why_not: AdministratorAccess — excessive permissions; credentials in environment variables are unnecessary and insecure; a public topic opens it to everyone.
